sections.briefing_summary: 本期内容涵盖前沿模型、AI 产品与平台，以及研究与治理。前沿模型方面，论文分别讨论对话式 AI 在用户偏好不确定性下的自适应个性化、兼顾零样本推理与持续学习的 AutoHebb 自修改神经网络，以及物理基础模型在仿真到现实微调中的灾难性遗忘。产品方面，datasette-llm 发布 0.1a9 版并可自动采用 LLM 默认模型，注重隐私的 AI 助手 Ollie 将在一周内关闭。研究与治理方面，内容包括 CoFiBreak 多轮越狱多样性奖励、剪枝冗余注意力头以抑制逐字记忆、Qistas 公平性评估协议、孟加拉语伊斯兰来源捏造基准 BILAL-BENCH，以及 NAACP 诉 xAI 数据中心污染案获准继续推进。
sections.briefing_title_en: AI & LLMs: Frontier Models, Products, and Governance
sections.briefing_summary_en: This edition covers frontier models, AI products and platforms, and research and governance. On frontier models, the papers discuss adaptive personalization for conversational AI under preference uncertainty, AutoHebb self-modifying neural networks combining zero-shot inference and continual learning, and catastrophic forgetting in a physics foundation model during sim-to-real fine-tuning. On products, datasette-llm released version 0.1a9 with automatic use of LLM’s default model, while privacy-focused AI assistant Ollie will shut down in a week. On research and governance, items include CoFiBreak’s diversity reward for multi-turn jailbreaks, pruning redundant attention heads to suppress verbatim memorization, the Qistas fairness evaluation protocol, the BILAL-BENCH benchmark for Islamic-source fabrication in Bengali, and a judge allowing the NAACP lawsuit over xAI data center pollution to proceed.
